settings.intro: From a quick reply to a long-form post, Quillcraft covers the whole writing journey in your voice — without forcing you into a rigid template.

features.title: Voice training that's instant
features.text: Paste in samples of your best writing. Quillcraft studies your rhythm, vocabulary, and phrasing, then matches it from the first draft.

features.title: Drafts in your tone
features.text: Tell Quillcraft the audience and the goal. It produces copy that sounds like you wrote it on a good day — not like a robot.

features.title: Rewrites with one click
features.text: Too long, too short, too casual, too formal. Quillcraft reworks any paragraph to hit the tone you're after, instantly.

features.title: Works where you write
features.text: Draft in our editor, or call Quillcraft from your email, docs, and CMS through a browser extension and API.

features.title: Fact-checks your claims
features.text: Quillcraft flags statements that need a source and suggests where to add proof, so your drafts are credible before they ship.

features.title: Style guide that sticks
features.text: Set your brand's voice rules once. Every draft respects them — no more scrubbing jargon or fixing passive voice by hand.

steps.title: Teach it your voice
steps.text: Share a few pieces of writing you love. Quillcraft builds your voice profile in seconds and keeps it private to your account.

steps.title: Describe what you need
steps.text: Tell it the piece, the audience, and the goal — an email, a blog post, a product page. No prompt formulas required.

steps.title: Get a first draft
steps.text: Quillcraft drafts in your tone. Read it, keep what works, and ask for rewrites where it misses.

steps.title: Polish and publish
steps.text: Run the built-in fact-check and style pass, then send it to your tools. You're done before your coffee's cold.

settings.note: Most people write their first on-voice piece within ten minutes of signing up. No prompt engineering degree, no guessing, no blank-page dread.

settings.title: Questions, answered
settings.intro: The honest answers people ask before moving their writing to Quillcraft.

items.question: Will the writing actually sound like me?
items.answer: That's the whole point. Quillcraft builds a voice profile from your own samples and matches your rhythm and phrasing. The more you write with it, the closer it gets.

items.question: Do I need to learn prompt engineering?
items.answer: No. You describe what you need in plain language. Quillcraft handles the rest — no formulas, no token math, no jargon.

items.question: Who owns my drafts and voice data?
items.answer: You do. Your drafts and voice profile are yours, exportable anytime. We never train shared models on your private content, and we delete your samples on request.

items.question: Can it replace my editor?
items.answer: No tool should. Quillcraft gets you a strong, on-voice first draft faster. You keep final say — and the fact-check and style pass make the edit lighter.
